  *(sofia‑4: “No. My own shopping is my business. I'd want my personal items somewhere the house can't see, or at least clearly apart from the shared things.”)*  

- Notification preferences need to be configurable to avoid overload, especially in larger households with many contributors.  
  *(daan‑5: “We tried an app that sent a notification each time anything was added, and I uninstalled it after two days.”)*
